outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter/dot plots with mean ± S.D. bars, and individual data points (dots/squares) for each of the n=5 mice per group are clearly overlaid.
Panel B shows representative gross photographs of mice, not a quantitative plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel C consists of representative H&E and Oil Red O micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows a 5mC dot blot and methylene blue staining images, which are raw blot images rather than a plot of averaged data.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue quantification is a bar chart with mean ± S.D., and individual data points for each animal (n=5 per group) are overlaid as dots/squares.

Panel F includes western blot images and a bar chart (bottom) of TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH ratios; the bar chart shows mean ± S.D. with individual data points (circles/squares) for each sample (n=6 NC, n=7 HFD) overlaid.
